author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a box with a slanted loop inside that read as a wallet or paperclip, with no hands visible. Now a 45-degree clasp between two short cuff bands at the edges: thumb with a rounded tip over the left hand, and the left hand's heel dropping into two scalloped fingertips with a knuckle line, then an index edge to the right cuff.
omissions: closed cuff outlines (a 6-wide band cannot keep 8 between its sides) and the third fingertip
